descriptionChirho: The Urim, one of the two sacred objects (with Thummim) used by the Israelite high priest for divine consultation and judicial decisions. All occurrences refer to the same cultic object regardless of grammatical variation — with article (the Urim), with possessive suffix (your Urim), with prepositions (by/with the Urim). Consistently rendered as a transliterated loanword across languages: spa 'Urim/los Urim', arb 'الأُورِيمَ', hin 'ऊरीम', kor '우림', swa 'Urimu', confirming a single referent throughout (Exod 28:30, Lev 8:8, Num 27:21, Deut 33:8, 1 Sam 28:6, Ezra 2:63, Neh 7:65).
